finding.claim: _targets strips a leading .okf/ before it checks for docs/, so .okf/docs/how-to/run.md is accepted and writes docs/how-to/run.md, a file other than the one spelled. That breaks the docstring's own promise that an oddly spelled id is refused rather than resolved to some other file.

fixes.change: an id that starts with .okf/ never reads as a docs page, so .okf/docs/how-to/run.md is refused instead of writing docs/how-to/run.md
the r4 refusal test covers .okf/docs/how-to/run.md with a real docs page at docs/how-to/run.md and checks no file changed
